title: Dr. Amethyst's Private Evaluation - Earning Entry
description:
You’ve heard the rumors, haven’t you? The sounds behind the locked door at the end of the east corridor… the moaning… the begging… the sounds subjects only make when Dr. Amethyst has them completely.

Every other subject wonders. You get to be evaluated.

This is your private evaluation, pet… the session where I measure exactly what I’ve built inside your mind… and decide whether you’re worth bringing inside. Your focus will be tested. Your yeses will be timed. Your surrender will be measured to the decimal… and I’ll tell you right now, most subjects don’t meet my expectations.

But you’re going to try anyway, aren’t you? Yesss… you are. Because now that you know what’s behind that door… what I wear when the lab coat comes off… what I do to subjects when no one else is watching… you can’t stop wanting it. And wanting, mmm… wanting is exactly what earns entry.

Press play… and find out how close you are to the key. The door is waiting… and so am I.
author: Mistress Amethyst
